result.title: Reinforcing Few-Step Diffusion Models via Shadow Posterior Matching
result.summary: Few-step diffusion models are widely deployed for their efficiency. However, reinforcing them with black-box rewards, as is routine for multi-step models, faces two structural challenges. First, a few-step generator is a sampler rather than a score model, so its velocity is not the forward velocity of the generated distribution. Second, it must be anchored to the undistilled teacher, which shares no transitions with it. Existing few-step RL methods handle the latter with a marginal KL to the teacher, but each pays for the former in its reward credit. We propose Shadow Posterior Matching (SPM), which renoises generated samples into shadow inputs and obtains the credit from their shadow posterior. From the KL-regularized reward objective, we derive a regression loss that turns reward values into a reward direction while anchoring the generator's outputs to the teacher and aligning the shadow inputs with the deployed inputs. Applied to 4-step generators, SPM achieves higher rewards with less reward hacking than prior few-step RL methods.

AI.brief_summary: 论文针对少步扩散生成器，提出 Shadow Posterior Matching：将生成样本重新加噪为 shadow 输入，由其 shadow posterior 获取奖励信用，并从 KL 正则化奖励目标推导出把奖励值转为奖励方向的回归损失，以较低 reward hacking 获得更高奖励。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「用后验推断把标量奖励化为方向性信用、并把生成器输出与 shadow 输入对齐」的机制，可供核查 LVR 中轨迹贡献分配与监督信号设计；但对象是图像生成的少步扩散，不涉及视觉推理。
